full_page.content:
1936, May 1 1942, April 18
The following is a faithful transcription of the messages written on Seraphic Mass Association cards by the Servant of God Father Solanus Casey O.F.M. Cap.
Mrs. Emma 4. Casey for speedy recovery, God willing - May 1, 1936
God bless you Emma, dear Sister Every time you think of opera- tion, Say "God help us" and then thank Him for it and for out-come
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Mrs. Mildred Conley - with baby and all concerned - April 28, 1942 One holy Mass Specially God bless you Mildred. - Congratulations. Do not worry.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
